{{Top|leg}}
A '''monomolecular slicer''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] part that could be added onto the digging claws of [[E-2 Asteroid Miner|E-2 asteroid mining vehicles]] to help them pierce tougher surfaces. They were found on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship ''[[Marauder Starjacker]]''.
